package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: TI NE5532 data sheet SLOS075K (revised December 2025), D/P/PS package pinout (onsemi's N/D8 the same)

fit.sheet: onsemi NE5532/D Rev. 2 (September 2013) and TI NE5532 data sheet SLOS075K (revised December 2025), NE5532 at ±15 V
fit.figure: onsemi electrical characteristics at ±15 V: AVOL 100 V/mV typ, GBW 10 MHz, slew rate 9 V/µs, follower overshoot 10 % (100 mVp-p, CL 100 pF, RL 600 Ω), supply current 8 mA for both amplifiers, VOUT ±13.5 V typ at RL ≥ 2 kΩ and ±13 V at 600 Ω
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. Phase margin 65.3° fitted so a follower at the sheet's load (600 Ω, 100 pF) overshoots 10 % (.claude/skills/fit-model/tools/opamp_pm_fit.py); output resistance 33.5 Ω and clamps 1.27 V from each rail fitted to both swing rows (simulated 1.47 V at 2 kΩ, 1.97 V at 600 Ω). Checked: slews at 8.85 V/µs.
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
